profile.name: Swapnil Mukherjee
profile.title: Technical Consultant @ Okta
profile.headline: I build the identity layer behind modern apps, from CIAM at scale to IAM for AI agents.
profile.shortBio: Technical Consultant at Okta helping enterprises design and deploy secure CIAM and IAM architectures, including identity patterns for AI agents, OAuth/OIDC, MFA, and Zero Trust access.
profile.about: Technical Consultant at Okta focused on Auth0, CIAM, and IAM for AI agents. I design secure authentication, authorization, MFA, federation, and extensibility patterns across modern app and API workloads. Previously owned production Auth0 operations for Fifth Third Bank’s Newline platform and supported enterprise IAM at Cardinal Health across 22,000+ identities and 100+ federated applications.
profile.availability: Open to consulting conversations and CIAM architecture reviews.

experience.summary: Technical Consultant supporting enterprise Auth0 and CIAM implementations, with a focus on secure authentication, authorization, extensibility, and IAM patterns for AI agents.
highlights: Lead customer consultation and integrations sessions for Auth0 CIAM across web, mobile, SPA, API, B2B, and B2C workloads, translating business requirements into secure implementation plans.
Advise on IAM for AI agents, including agent authorization, delegated access, token exchange patterns, consent, scoped API access, and secure user-to-agent interactions.
Implement and optimize Universal Login, Organizations, Actions, MFA, Attack Protection, RBAC, custom domains, and enterprise/social identity provider integrations.
Troubleshoot OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, token claims, sessions, redirects, extensibility code, and federation issues across production Auth0 tenants.
Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Product to unblock deployments, improve adoption, and feed customer requirements back into platform teams.
Create reusable implementation guidance for CIAM security, Zero Trust access, API authorization, and operational readiness.

experience.summary: CIAM engineer for the Newline commercial banking platform. Owned production Auth0 operations, hardened authentication flows, and planned the target-state migration architecture from Auth0 to Ping Identity with zero unplanned downtime.
highlights: Owned production Auth0 tenant operations for Newline, including tenant configuration, custom domains, application onboarding, release support, and day-two operations.
Designed and operated SSO and MFA journeys using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML, aligned to Zero Trust principles and financial-services security standards.

Planned and architected the Auth0-to-Ping Identity migration strategy, covering gap analysis, target-state design, schema planning, attribute mapping, claim design, user profile migration, app re-onboarding, and cutover testing.
Built Auth0 Actions, Rules, and Hooks in JavaScript and REST APIs for token enrichment, registration, credential recovery, and step-up authentication.
Implemented Terraform-based CI/CD for IAM configuration using GitHub and Jenkins, creating version-controlled, auditable, approval-gated promotion paths across environments.
Partnered with application, infrastructure, HR, and security teams to improve lifecycle access patterns, reduce CIAM incidents, and support audit readiness.

experience.summary: Okta SME and IAM platform engineer for a regulated healthcare enterprise, supporting 22,000+ workforce identities, 100+ federated applications, and core access governance workflows.
highlights: Served as Okta subject matter expert for 22,000+ workforce identities across cloud, on-prem, B2E, B2B, and B2C application environments.
Led an 8-engineer team through migration of legacy applications to Okta-based SSO, federating 100+ applications with SAML and Active Directory integrations.
Operated SailPoint IdentityIQ for account aggregation, connector configuration, access governance, and joiner-mover-leaver workflows across AD, Okta, and enterprise systems.
Partnered with CyberArk and SailPoint teams to improve privileged access patterns, reduce unmanaged administrator access, and strengthen identity governance controls.
Supported Linux and Red Hat infrastructure, proxy services, and IAM platform operations, automating upgrade routines and reducing change-window risk.
Deployed and tuned MFA and adaptive access policies across legacy and cloud platforms aligned to HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and enterprise security requirements.

experience.summary: Software development intern building automation and internal tooling for network operations, with an early focus on secure APIs, logging, and credential handling.
highlights: Built JavaScript and Python automation scripts and internal APIs to streamline deployment, environment setup, and operational workflows for network tooling.
Designed routines for logging, health checks, credential handling, and access control, building a foundation for later IAM and security engineering work.

projects.title: TripShare
projects.summary: Smart carpooling platform with route-matching algorithms and full-stack user management.
projects.description: End-to-end platform that matches travelers with overlapping itineraries to cut cost and emissions. Built user registration, trip-matching, and a CMS-backed admin layer; layered in market-research-driven personas and a CI/CD pipeline for smooth deploys.

projects.title: FAST Firmware Fuzzer
projects.summary: Advanced fuzzing framework that surfaces blind spots in firmware specifications and legacy systems.
projects.description: Evolved the SAFIREFUZZ framework into a fuzzer that fuses specification, code, and test-suite signals to expose SPEC blind spots in firmware. Resolved core bugs and added legacy-system integrations.

projects.title: Pizzeria Manager
projects.summary: Java + SQL backend simulating store operations, inventory, and order processing.
projects.description: OO-designed Java framework with a structured SQL schema for a simulated pizza chain, modular, scalable, and capable of handling multiple order types and inventory flows.

projects.title: DROWN Attack
projects.summary: Executed the DROWN attack against SSLv2 servers to recover keys and demonstrate protocol risk.
projects.description: Performed a full DROWN (Decrypting RSA with Obsolete and Weakened eNcryption) assessment: brute-forced SSLv2 to recover the server's private key, then implemented mitigation strategies.

projects.title: Space Hangman
projects.summary: Flask + HTML5 web game that wires multiple external APIs into a celestial Hangman.
projects.description: Reimagined Hangman with a space theme. Flask backend, HTML5/CSS frontend, and several external APIs woven in to keep gameplay dynamic.

projects.title: System Monitoring Tool
projects.summary: Python CLI for real-time tracking of CPU, memory, and network metrics with anomaly alerts.
projects.description: Built around psutil for collection and matplotlib for live visualization, the tool surfaces CPU load, memory pressure, and network activity, with alerting for anomalous behavior.

projects.title: VoiceRx
projects.summary: Voice-driven EMR interface using Amazon Alexa to automate clinical data entry.
projects.description: An Alexa-powered voice UI for Electronic Medical Records that automates data entry and updates so clinicians can interact with EMRs via voice, streamlining workflows and reducing administrative burden.

projects.title: HealthFit
projects.summary: Wellness app providing personalized daily caloric targets via REST APIs.
projects.description: Python + REST application that recommends daily caloric intake based on a user's weight management goals, backed by research-grounded heuristics and OAuth-secured endpoints.

projects.title: TweetFeel
projects.summary: NLP sentiment engine using RNNs to extract emotional structure from tweets.
projects.description: End-to-end NLP pipeline: text preprocessing, embeddings, and recurrent neural networks to surface emotional structure from tweet streams.

projects.title: Neural Style Transfer
projects.summary: Deep-learning app that fuses content and style images for art and therapeutic use.
projects.description: Implemented neural style transfer in Python, combining a content image with the style of a reference image via deep networks and optimization, with explorations into therapeutic applications.

projects.title: IoT Home Automation
projects.summary: Java-based NodeMCU firmware enabling remote control of traditional appliances.
projects.description: NodeMCU + Java firmware that brings legacy appliances onto the network at low cost, a take on accessible smart-home retrofitting.

projects.title: Fraud Detection
projects.summary: ML pipeline using K-Nearest Neighbour tuned for highly imbalanced credit-transaction data.
projects.description: Built a KNN-based fraud detector with custom feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, and tailored distance metrics. Evaluated with precision-recall curves and confusion matrices to maximize recall.
